svg.title: Data preparation pipeline comparison
svg.desc: Across the training rows, raw item count has a loose relationship with packing time, while items per active packer has a clear rising relationship. Repeated cross-validation MAE is 18.86 minutes for raw columns, 18.57 for a log SKU feature, 4.67 for a workload ratio, and 3.74 for both derived features.
svg.title: Data preparation feature relationships and pipeline comparison

cc:Work.dc:title: Data preparation feature relationships and pipeline comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Two scatter plots compare raw item count with items per packer, followed by repeated cross-validation errors for four preparation pipelines.
